text: Accountant. Prepare monthly closings, journal entries and account reconciliations. Maintain the general ledger, accounts payable and receivable, and support the annual audit. Requirements: degree in accounting, GAAP knowledge, advanced Excel, ERP experience (SAP or QuickBooks).

Client Advocate. Represent and support clients in social services and legal processes, coordinate with case managers and community organizations, document cases and ensure clients' rights are respected. Requirements: experience in advocacy or case management, strong communication, knowledge of community resources.

Agricultural Specialist. Advise farmers on crop production, soil management and pest control, run field trials and extension programs, and collect agronomic data. Requirements: degree in agronomy or agricultural science, field experience, knowledge of irrigation and sustainable farming.

Apparel Merchandiser. Plan assortments for clothing collections, follow trends, work with buyers and vendors on product development and pricing, and analyze sell-through. Requirements: experience in fashion retail or merchandising, product knowledge, analytical skills.

Arts Program Coordinator. Organize exhibitions, workshops and community art programs, manage artists and budgets, and promote events. Requirements: background in fine arts or art education, event planning, creativity, grant writing a plus.

Automotive Technician. Diagnose and repair vehicles, perform maintenance on engines, brakes, transmissions and electrical systems, and use diagnostic tools. Requirements: automotive training or ASE certification, experience in a dealership or repair shop.

Aviation Maintenance Technician. Inspect, maintain and repair aircraft systems according to FAA regulations, document work orders and support flight operations safety. Requirements: A&P license or military aviation experience, knowledge of aircraft systems.

BPO Team Lead. Manage a customer support team in a call center, monitor KPIs such as average handle time and customer satisfaction, coach agents and handle escalations. Requirements: experience in BPO or contact center operations, team leadership.

Banking Relationship Manager. Manage client portfolios, open accounts, sell loans and banking products, ensure compliance with KYC and AML rules, and grow branch deposits. Requirements: retail banking experience, customer service, sales targets.

Business Development Manager. Identify new markets and partners, generate leads, negotiate contracts and build long-term client relationships to grow revenue. Requirements: B2B sales or business development experience, CRM, negotiation, strategic planning.

Chef de Cuisine. Lead the kitchen team, design menus, control food costs and inventory, and ensure food safety and quality standards. Requirements: culinary degree or equivalent, experience as sous chef or chef, ServSafe certification.

Construction Project Manager. Plan and supervise construction projects, manage subcontractors, schedules and budgets, and enforce site safety (OSHA). Requirements: experience in construction management, blueprint reading, cost estimation.

Management Consultant. Analyze client business problems, run workshops, build recommendations and support implementation of process improvements. Requirements: consulting experience, problem solving, presentation skills, project management.

Graphic Designer. Create visual identities, marketing materials, web and print layouts, and collaborate with marketing teams. Requirements: portfolio, Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator and InDesign, typography and branding skills.

Digital Media Specialist. Produce and manage content for social media and websites, run digital campaigns, analyze engagement with Google Analytics and optimize SEO. Requirements: experience in digital marketing, content creation, video editing.

Engineering Specialist. Design, test and improve mechanical or electrical systems, write technical documentation and support manufacturing. Requirements: engineering degree, CAD tools, quality and process improvement, technical problem solving.

Financial Analyst. Build financial models, budgets and forecasts, analyze variances and prepare reports for management decisions. Requirements: degree in finance, Excel modeling, FP&A experience, knowledge of financial statements.

Fitness Trainer. Design personalized training programs, lead group exercise classes and coach clients on nutrition and healthy habits. Requirements: personal trainer certification (NASM, ACE), CPR, experience in a gym or fitness center.

Healthcare Coordinator. Coordinate patient care, schedule appointments, maintain medical records and ensure compliance with HIPAA. Requirements: experience in a hospital or clinic, medical terminology, EMR systems, patient care.

Human Resources Generalist. Manage recruitment, onboarding, employee relations, benefits and payroll, and ensure compliance with labor law. Requirements: HR experience, HRIS, knowledge of employment law, interviewing.

IT Support Specialist. Install and maintain hardware, software and networks, manage user accounts, troubleshoot incidents and ensure system security. Requirements: IT experience, Windows and Active Directory, networking, help desk ticketing.

Public Relations Specialist. Write press releases, manage media relations, organize events and protect the brand reputation. Requirements: PR or communications degree, media contacts, excellent writing, social media.

Sales Representative. Prospect new customers, present products, close sales and meet monthly quotas while maintaining customer relationships. Requirements: sales experience, CRM, negotiation, customer service.

Teacher. Plan and deliver lessons, assess students, manage the classroom and communicate with parents. Requirements: teaching certification, classroom experience, curriculum development, differentiated instruction.
